top_signals.title: UK to look at making software companies liable for cyber breaches
top_signals.summary: The new U.K. budget says the government will "consider where liability for cyber breaches should sit," potentially a landmark shift for a country that has relied on voluntary codes to encourage software vendors to improve security.
